messages:
toni_marketing: Quick request for the launch appendix + webinar: marketing needs a defendable A/B bench that compares redwood-v2-7b vs v2-13b across FP, q8, and q4. Goal: pick a single PR-safe sentence for the deck and an appendix artifact we can hand to legal. Need: 1) 20 sanitized payloads (short/med/long/edge) labeled by intent, 2) per-request latencies & token counts (no prompt text) across 3 independent trials, 3) cold-start (first 30 reqs) heatmap + warmed p50/p95/p99, 4) exact copy-paste run commands for Hosted and Dedicated, 5) quantization recipe + model commit hashes + provenance line. Deadline: tomorrow 8am PT. @sam_runtime @jia_eng :pray:

sam_runtime: We can do that. Couple clarifying q's: do you want streaming metrics included anywhere? And do you want the A/B to be run under identical batch/seq settings or allow model-specific tuning?

toni_marketing: Headline numbers should be non-stream token timings. Run all models with identical config: seq=512, batch=1, greedy (temp=0). We want apples-to-apples. Streaming note can live in appendix.

jia_eng: For repeats, recommend fresh process restarts between trials to capture cold noise. Well run 3 trials each (fresh start). Also, quant recipes: q8 uses recipe_q8_v1; q4 uses recipe_q4_v2. Well record exact git-sha for the model artifacts.

sam_runtime: Plan: produce a package at miniab/2355550000/ containing: payloads.json (20 items), manifest.csv (payload_id,intent,edge_flag,sanitized_flag), run_hosted.sh, run_dedicated.sh, per_request_{model}_{trial}.csv (trial_id,req_idx,latency_ms,token_count), summary.csv (p50/p95/p99,mean,ci_lower,ci_upper), README.md (provenance + one-line recommended PR sentence). We'll also include a small note about variance sources and an optional profiler snapshot for one cold request per model.

leo_metrics: I'll compute bootstrap 95% CI on p95/p99 across the 3 trials and add a tiny delta table q4_vs_fp and q8_vs_fp with percent change and CI. Legal asked for a suggested neutral phrasing we can paste if numbers hold. We'll provide both precise numbers and a conservative suggested sentence.

sam_runtime: Example copyable commands we'll include: Hosted:

REDWOOD_API_KEY=... ./run_hosted.sh --model redwood-v2-7b:stable --quant q4 --payloads payloads.json --seq 512 --batch 1 --warmup 200 --repeats 3 --out out/2355550000/v2-7b-q4

Dedicated example (runs on prod pool):

./run_dedicated.sh --model redwood-v2-13b:stable --quant fp --seq 512 --batch 1 --warmup 200 --repeats 3 --pool prod-a10g --out out/2355550000/v2-13b-fp

jia_eng: We'll sanitize any third-party text and flag sanitized items in the manifest. If marketing wants a "real-world-like" long prompt, we'll provide a sanitized analog and mark it.

toni_marketing: Legal requires the provenance string exactly as: run_by:<name>; run_ts:<UTC ISO>; model_tag:<tag>; commit:<git-sha>; quant_recipe:<name>. Please put that in README.md and in the artifact root.

sam_runtime: Noted. We'll also attach raw per-request CSVs (no prompt text) so metrics can reproduce CI. We'll upload tarball to staging and post GS link.

artifact-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/miniab/2355550000/ab-quant-pack.tar.gz (payloads.json, manifest.csv, run_hosted.sh, run_dedicated.sh, per_request_*.csv, summary.csv, README.md, profiler_snapshots/)

leo_metrics: Two quick notes for marketing: 1) if you want a PR-safe one-liner we recommend conservative wording that includes CI (e.g., "Measured p95 latency for q4 was X ms (+Y% vs FP, 95% CI [a,b]) on redwood-v2-7b:stable."); 2) quant deltas vary by payload length; we'll include a small stratified table.

toni_marketing: Perfect. We'll review the artifact first thing and share the recommended sentence with legal. If legal asks for a re-run, we will include the artifact id and ask for an identical re-run. Thanks team! :rocket:
